established: A pilot verification profile (warrant-pilot/profile@1) is canonical JSON of the verifier entry point, boot-script and provider-module digests (the provider identity checked against them), rule version, runtime, explicit axioms and execution-profile assumptions; its id is its SHA-256 address, recomputed by the receiver; changing any declared operand alone gives another id while the old profile stays addressable, and a missing or extra member, an unpinned or mismatched pin, or a second encoding is refused.
